cohort: 2876 nulliparous women at term with spontaneous labor
finding: Epidural analgesia was associated with a lower intrapartum cesarean delivery rate in nulliparous women at term with spontaneous labor, which may be explained by a reduction in the risk of maternal request for cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Epidural analgesia was associated with a lower rate of intrapartum cesarean delivery in nulliparous women with spontaneous labor.
